correctness.rationale: Independent C++17 exact Z[phi] enumeration reconstructed all 120 scaled vertices and independently looped over all C(119,4)=7,940,751 fixed-anchor quintuples. It found 109 levels, 687241 zero determinants anchored, largest 12+24phi with frequency 100, and runner-up 16+20phi with frequency 450. By vertex-transitivity multiply by 24, obtaining 16,493,784 degenerate quintuples and 2400 maximizers. Coordinatewise convexity of absolute affine determinant extends the maximum to all simplices contained in the 600-cell. Verification of ring class uses exact coefficient pairing; independent sign comparator used high-precision golden-ratio numerical sign, while package script gives exact integer sign logic. No claim of all continuous equality cases.
